text:
Alex: Heads up — our upstairs grinder sounded like a dying robot this morning. Coffee puckage is sad. Anyone want to swing by Common Grounds roastery on 3rd to grab fresh beans? Also quick poll: almond biscotti or chocolate biscotti with the beans? :coffee:
Priya: I can check the grinder quick — might just need a quick de-crumb. If it's the motor we need a replacement.
Sam: I can do the run at 12:30, can pick up beans + oatmilk. Preference: chocolate biscotti :chocolate_bar:
Jen: Decaf and oatmilk please. Also leave a note to restock sugar packets.
KitchenBot: stock levels — beans: LOW, decaf pods: 6, oatmilk: 1 carton, biscotti: 3 packs (2 almond, 1 chocolate)
Riley: Almond for me! but chocolate if we're short. Happy to chip $5 for the run.
Alex: Thanks Sam! If it's a long line pls grab the pre-ground medium roast. Tag me when you head out.
Sam: On my way. ETA 25m. Paying via Venmo @sam-dev. Anyone else?
Priya: I'll stir the grinder and leave a sticky note if it's noisy. Thanks Sam :thumbsup:
Jen: Thanks everyone — snacks make ops tolerable. Post a pic of the haul pls :camera_with_flash:
